meta.name: Playful Editorial E-commerce
meta.purpose: Context file for AI code generation. Use to build landing pages and storefront sections in a consistent visual language. Content-agnostic: swap in any product, brand, and copy.
meta.source: Extracted from a single desktop landing page screenshot. Color values are visually estimated; verify against any official brand file.

designStyle.summary: Bold, warm, playful food/lifestyle e-commerce. Flat color blocking, oversized heavy uppercase headlines, pill-shaped controls, thin black outlines, and small decorative stickers. Feels like modern editorial packaging design translated to the web.
principles: Large flat fields of saturated, warm color define each section. No gradients.
Typography does the heavy lifting: very bold, uppercase, tightly set display text against small quiet body text.
Black is the only neutral for text, borders, and primary buttons. It anchors the loud palette.
Rounded everything: pills for controls, large radii for cards and image frames.
Structure through 1px black outlines instead of shadows.
Product or lifestyle imagery is saturated, studio-lit, and shot on solid colored backdrops that echo the page palette.
Small decorative marks (stars, flowers, dots, stickers) add personality without cluttering layouts.
avoid: Drop shadows, glassmorphism, gradients, or blur effects
Thin or light font weights for headlines
Cool grays, blues, or corporate neutrals
Sharp 0px corners on buttons, cards, or image frames
Dense text blocks or long paragraphs in hero areas
More than one filled primary button style

colorPalette.usageRule: Each section gets ONE dominant background color. Text and borders are near-black. Accents appear only in small decorative elements or badges.

ink.role: Primary text, borders, primary button fill, top strip background, device/frame outline

paper.role: Marquee/ticker band background, text on black buttons

cream.role: Content section background, nav pill background, card interior

blush.role: Outer page background, large decorative surrounds

sun.role: Decorative starburst or highlight shapes on dark/mid backgrounds

colorPalette.contrastNotes: Ink on olive, cream, and blush all pass AA for large and body text. Never place cream or white text directly on olive or blush.

display.description: Ultra-heavy grotesque sans, uppercase, slightly condensed feel, tight tracking.

body.description: Clean neo-grotesque sans, regular weight, small sizes.

logo.description: Lowercase italic serif wordmark, small, inside the nav pill. Use only for the brand mark.

rules: Headlines are ALWAYS uppercase, heavy, and tightly leaded (0.9 to 1.0).
Body and UI text stays small (10 to 14px), and uppercase is used for nav, buttons, and ticker labels.
Extreme size contrast between display and body is a defining trait. Do not use mid-size headings (20 to 28px) in the hero area.
Only one headline style per section.

borders.note: Cards use a thin outline instead of a shadow. The outer device or page frame uses a thick black stroke.

shape.elevation: none. Flat design with zero box-shadows.

pageStructure.name: TopStrip
pageStructure.description: Thin full-width near-black band with a row of small, evenly spaced coral star/asterisk dots as decoration.

pageStructure.name: PageSurround
pageStructure.description: Wide blush background that frames the main content container with generous top padding.

pageStructure.name: MainFrame
pageStructure.description: Central container with thick black outline and large rounded corners. Holds all sections below, clipped to the radius.

pageStructure.name: Header
pageStructure.description: Floating cream pill navigation bar, inset from the top of the hero by about 16px. Logo left, three centered links, a single icon button (cart/bag) right.

pageStructure.name: Hero
pageStructure.description: Olive section with 2 columns. Left column: oversized headline, one line of body copy, one black pill CTA, and a decorative star placed overlapping the top-left of the headline. Right column: large rounded image panel.

pageStructure.name: Ticker
pageStructure.description: Full-width white band with a repeating horizontal sequence of small uppercase words separated by tiny coral icon dots. Infinite marquee.

pageStructure.name: ProductGrid
pageStructure.description: Cream section holding a 3-column grid of outlined product cards.

responsive.tablet: Hero stacks (text above image), product grid becomes 2 columns, nav links remain.
responsive.mobile: Single column everywhere, nav collapses to logo + icon button + menu toggle, headline scales via clamp(), ticker continues to scroll, frame border reduces to 3px.

navPill.content: Logo (italic serif, ~16px) left, 3 uppercase links centered with 32px gap, icon button right.

primaryButton.hover: Invert to paper background with ink text and 1px ink border, or lift 2px via translateY.

quantityStepper.layout: minus control left, value centered, plus control right

stack: Product image (portrait, transparent or cut-out, ~60% of card width, centered)
Add-to-cart button (primary, full width, label + price on one line)

badgeSticker.shape: scalloped flower or circle with soft wavy edge
badgeSticker.position: absolute, overlapping the top-right corner of a card, slightly outside the border

heroImagePanel.content: Studio photo on a split two-tone backdrop (peach and pink) with props in complementary warm tones.

decorativeStar.shape: 8 to 10 pointed starburst or flower with rounded petals
decorativeStar.position: absolute, overlapping hero headline top-left edge
decorativeStar.behindOrAbove: above background, below text if overlapping

ticker.separator: small coral icon dot or mini-star, 12px
ticker.animation: linear infinite horizontal scroll, 25 to 40s per loop, pause on hover

photography.style: Studio product photography, soft top light, saturated and warm, solid colored backdrops (often split into two tones), small props such as bowls, cloth, and scattered ingredients.
photography.composition: Products clustered at slight angles, one or two tilted, shallow depth of field optional.
photography.colorMatching: Backdrop and props should come from the same warm family as the page palette (pink, peach, coral, olive).

packagingMockups.style: Cut-out standing pouches or jars with transparent background, centered inside cards.
packagingMockups.artDirection: Packaging graphics are loud, illustrative, and hand-drawn, with chunky custom lettering and flat color shapes in the same warm palette.

imagery.illustrationAndShapes: Flat vector, no outlines, no gradients, organic blob and flower shapes.

motion.note: Not visible in a static screenshot. Suggested to match the style.
patterns: Buttons: small lift or color invert on hover.
Decorative star/badge: slow rotation (20 to 30s) or gentle wiggle on hover.
Cards: translateY(-4px) on hover, no shadow added.
Section reveal: fade and rise 16px on scroll.

accessibility.contrast: Keep ink text on light/mid backgrounds. Do not place accent colors behind small text.
accessibility.focusState: 3px solid ink outline with 2px offset, plus a sun-colored inner ring on dark surfaces.
accessibility.ticker: Provide prefers-reduced-motion fallback (static, wrapped list) and aria-hidden on duplicated items.
accessibility.touchTargets: Minimum 40px height for pills and steppers on mobile.
accessibility.decorative: Stars, dots, and stickers are aria-hidden.

aiInstructions.howToUse: When generating a page or component, follow these rules strictly so output stays consistent with this system.
buildOrder: 1. Set page and section backgrounds with flat palette colors only.
2. Establish the outer frame (thick ink border, large radius, overflow hidden).
4. Build a two-column hero: giant uppercase display headline plus one short line of body copy plus one primary pill CTA, paired with a rounded image panel.
6. Build the card grid with thin ink outlines, centered display titles, centered product images, pill stepper, and full-width black pill button.
7. Add decorative stars, dots, and a sticker badge last, using absolute positioning.
hardRules: All buttons and inputs are fully pill-shaped.
Headlines are uppercase, weight 800+, line-height 0.9 to 1.0.
Use only ink for text and borders. Accent colors are decoration only.
Every section has exactly one background color from the palette.
Cards are outlined (1px ink) and have a transparent fill.
Keep copy minimal: short headline, one supporting line, one CTA per hero.
Use CSS variables from cssTokens for every color, radius, and font.
variationsAllowed: Swap the section background palette to any warm saturated trio while keeping ink for text and borders.
Change number of cards (2 to 4) while keeping equal-width columns.
Flip hero columns (image left, text right).
Replace the starburst with any flat organic shape in an accent color.
aiInstructions.placeholderGuidance: Use neutral placeholders for content, e.g. 'HEADLINE WORD', 'Short supporting sentence.', 'PRIMARY ACTION', '$00'. Use solid-color rounded rectangles for missing imagery.
